description: This file implements a command-line interface (CLI) command for viewing logs of agent nodes in the AgentField control plane. It defines commands, flags, and methods to display or follow logs for specific agent nodes, including reading registry data and executing tail commands.

classes.name: LogViewer
classes.description: A class that handles viewing logs for agent nodes, including displaying, tailing, and following log files.

methods.name: runLogsCommand
methods.description: Executes the logs command, initializing LogViewer and displaying logs for a specified agent node.

methods.name: ViewLogs
methods.description: Displays logs for a given agent node, either tailing or following the log file.

methods.name: tailLogs
methods.description: Shows the last N lines of a log file using the tail command.

methods.name: followLogs
methods.description: Follows the log file in real-time using the tail -f command.
